title.zh: Nvidia发布RTX Spark：基于Arm的高效PC芯片
title.en: Nvidia announces the RTX Spark, an Arm-based consumer chip family it calls “the most efficient PC chip ever built”, made on TSMC 3 in partnership with MediaTek

title.en: Anthropic says it has confidentially filed for an IPO, which could happen as soon as this fall, joining OpenAI and SpaceX in preparing to go public in 2026

summary.zh: Anthropic已秘密提交IPO申请，计划2026年与OpenAI和SpaceX一同上市。

title.en: Florida AG James Uthmeier sues OpenAI and Sam Altman, seeking to hold Altman personally liable for deceptive trade practices, negligence, and public nuisance

summary.zh: 指控Altman涉及欺骗性商业行为、过失和公共妨害，寻求个人责任追究。

summary.zh: Anthropic、OpenAI和SpaceX成为Nvidia新款Vera CPU的首批用户，性能比x86芯片快1.8倍。

summary.zh: 结合Unitree H2 Plus机器人和Sharpa五指机械手，搭载Jetson Thor芯片。

summary.zh: 搭载GB300 Grace Blackwell芯片，内存高达748GB，可运行1万亿参数模型。

summary.zh: 基于Xe3P架构，采用LPDDR5X内存，专为“智能AI”设计。

title.en: Sources: at Build, Microsoft plans to unveil a Copilot “super app”, a new reasoning model developed by Microsoft AI, and Windows improvements for developers

summary.zh: 微软计划在Build大会上推出一款Copilot“超级应用”，展示其AI团队开发的新推理模型，并为开发者提供Windows改进。

summary.zh: AI初创公司Runway计划到2028年底在英国AI生态系统中投资超过2亿美元，并将伦敦设为其欧洲总部。

summary.zh: 由前Meta CTO Mike Schroepfer联合创立的气候科技风投公司Gigascale Capital完成2.5亿美元基金，支持早期阶段的AI相关初创公司。

summary.zh: 根据PitchBook数据，美国一半的独角兽公司三年未融资，220多家公司已成为“堕落独角兽”。

title.en: Beijing-based Vast, which uses AI models to generate 3D assets from text and image prompts, raised ~$200M at a $1B+ valuation, and says it has 20M global users

summary.zh: Vast利用AI模型从文本和图像生成3D资产，已拥有2000万全球用户，最新融资2亿美元，估值超过10亿美元。

title.zh: Mecka AI完成6000万美元融资，用于机器人训练
title.en: New York City-based Mecka AI, which trains robots with human data sourced from body sensors and iPhones, raised $60M, including a $25M Series A

summary.zh: 总部位于纽约的Mecka AI通过人体传感器和iPhone数据训练机器人，完成6000万美元融资，其中包括2500万美元A轮融资。

title.zh: 量子计算初创公司Quantinuum计划IPO，目标融资14.6亿美元
title.en: SEC filing: quantum computing startup Quantinuum boosts its IPO, aiming to sell 26.5M shares for $53-$55 each, raising up to $1.46B at an up to $14.3B valuation

summary.zh: 根据SEC文件，Quantinuum计划通过IPO发行2650万股，价格区间为53至55美元，估值最高达143亿美元。

title.zh: Strava新增API访问月费并限制公开资料访问
title.en: Strava is adding an $11.99 monthly fee for developer API access and moving public profiles and fitness club listings behind authentication to combat AI scraping

summary.zh: Strava将对开发者API访问收取每月11.99美元费用，并将公共资料和健身俱乐部列表移至身份验证后，以应对AI数据抓取问题。

title.zh: 分析发现中国军方自2019年以来500多次采购Nvidia芯片
title.en: Wirescreen analysis of 3,800 Chinese military procurement records finds 500+ instances since 2019 where the PLA sought Nvidia chips, including the A100 and A800

summary.zh: 研究显示，中国军方采购记录中多次涉及Nvidia A100和A800芯片。

title.zh: 美军主导的黑客马拉松“监狱突破行动”探讨AI与武器系统整合
title.en: A look at Operation Jailbreak, a US Army-led hackathon where nine defense firms use AI to integrate weapons systems, drawing on Ukraine interoperability lessons

summary.zh: 活动吸取乌克兰战场经验，九家国防公司参与，探索AI在武器系统中的应用。

title.zh: 微软即将推出统一的Copilot超级应用
title.en: New screenshots of upcoming Copilot Super App (2 minute read)

summary.zh: 新应用整合了GitHub Copilot、Cowork和Scout等功能，提升用户采用率。
summary.en: Microsoft looks likely to debut its unified Copilot app at Build 2026. Leaked screenshots show a GitHub Copilot tab, a Cowork tab, and a tab for Scout, an always-on AI agent. The company is trying to boost weak adoption by folding scattered tools into a single home. The integration of Teams hints that Scout may be able to run remotely.

title.zh: MiniMax M3模型：支持超长上下文窗口的开源模型
title.en: MiniMax M3 (2 minute read)

summary.zh: 该模型支持图像和视频输入，可执行桌面操作，适用于代码和代理任务。
summary.en: MiniMax M3 is an open weights model that achieves frontier-level performance on coding and agentic work. The model supports image and video input and can operate a desktop computer. It uses a new attention architecture that enables context scaling and can support ultra-long context windows of up to 1 million tokens. The model is available through MiniMax Code, the Token Plan, and MiniMax's API services.

title.zh: NVIDIA将在2026年Computex发布N1X笔记本芯片
title.en: Computex 2026 Will Be NVIDIA's Biggest Event Of The Year. Here's What To Expect (5 minute read)

summary.zh: 新芯片拥有20个ARM核心和RTX 5070级别GPU，并推出“Vera Rubin”AI平台。
summary.en: Nvidia plans to unveil its N1X laptop chip at Computex 2026, featuring 20 ARM cores and an RTX 5070 equivalent GPU, promising improved VRAM allocation for AI applications. The company will also present its "Vera Rubin" AI platform for datacenters, aiming to strengthen its position in the AI market. Nvidia's focus on Physical and Agentic AI will highlight advancements in autonomous machines and robotics, while gaming announcements seem minimal.

title.zh: Claude Opus 4.8系统卡发布
title.en: Claude Opus 4.8: The System Card (40 minute read)

summary.zh: 新版本系统卡长达244页，更新内容较小，但揭示了与Mythos的差异。
summary.en: Claude Opus 4.8, released only six weeks after Opus 4.7, comes with a 244-page system card. While the updates are incremental, there is still a lot to talk about. Its capabilities are still well behind Mythos. This post looks at the system card, what's different between the two versions, and what this reveals about Mythos.

title.zh: Bonsai Image 4B：适用于本地设备的图像生成模型
title.en: Introducing 1-bit and Ternary Bonsai Image 4B: Image Generation for Local Devices (9 minute read)

summary.zh: 1-bit和三值变体分别针对内存受限和高质量图像生成需求，支持iPhone运行。
summary.en: Bonsai Image 4B is a family of compact image-generation models that can run high-quality diffusion inference on local hardware. The 1-bit variant is for applications where memory pressure, bandwidth, and deployment footprint are the primary restraints. The ternary variant has more representational flexibility, giving it improved visual quality and prompt fidelity while remaining extremely compact. The models can run directly on an iPhone.

title.zh: Grok Build 0.1 API公测上线
title.en: Grok Build 0.1 on API (1 minute read)

summary.zh: xAI推出的模型专注于代理编程任务，支持多平台集成，提供高效的处理速度。
summary.en: xAI's grok-build-0.1 is now in public beta via the API, designed for agentic coding tasks like web development and debugging. The model processes over 100 tokens/second, costing $1 per million tokens in and $2 per million out. It integrates well with platforms like Grok Build, Cursor, and OpenClaw.

title.zh: 企业AI代理的瓶颈在于权限管理而非模型性能
title.en: The AI agent bottleneck isn't model performance — it's permissions (3 minute read)

summary.zh: Workday通过权限管理和与Gemini集成解决企业AI代理的合规性问题。
summary.en: Enterprise AI agents are struggling due to permissioning issues rather than model performance. Workday addresses this by using its system of record as the governance layer, integrating with Google's Gemini, and emphasizing agent accuracy. This setup ensures agents operate within defined user permissions, crucial for regulated sectors like HR and finance.

title.zh: 前DeepMind研究员筹集5000万美元开发科学问题AI
title.en: Ex-DeepMind researchers raised $50M to build AI that figures out which scientific questions are worth asking (4 minute read)

summary.zh: 伦敦AI实验室Inherent开发Faraday平台，专注于识别值得研究的科学问题。
summary.en: Inherent, a London-based AI lab, is building a platform called Faraday aimed at figuring out which questions are worth asking.

title.zh: OpenAI发布可信第三方AI模型评估指南
title.en: OpenAI Outlines Playbook for Trustworthy Third-Party AI Model Evaluations (4 minute read)

summary.zh: OpenAI于5月28日发布了一份全面指南，介绍如何对前沿AI模型（如GPT-5.5）进行可信的第三方评估。
summary.en: OpenAI published a comprehensive guide on May 28 for conducting trustworthy third-party evaluations of frontier AI models like GPT-5.5.

title.zh: 微软发布Project Solara，面向代理优先设备的安卓平台
title.en: Microsoft unveils Project Solara, an Android-based platform for agent-first devices, with concept hardware and pilots planned at Best Buy, Target, and others

summary.zh: 计划在Best Buy、Target等进行概念硬件和试点项目。

summary.zh: 引发对更多资本筹集的担忧。

title.zh: 微软发布首个高级推理AI模型MAI-Thinking-1
title.en: Microsoft debuts MAI-Thinking-1, its first advanced reasoning AI model, trained “from the ground up on clean data, without distillation from third-party models”

summary.zh: 从零开始基于干净数据训练，无第三方模型蒸馏。

title.zh: 微软推出企业AI代理Scout，基于OpenClaw构建
title.en: Microsoft announces Scout, an always-on enterprise AI agent built on OpenClaw, appearing as a Microsoft Teams contact to automate tasks like scheduling and more

summary.zh: 作为Microsoft Teams联系人出现，可自动化任务如日程安排等。

title.zh: 微软发布量子芯片Majorana 2，计划2029年推出商用量子计算机
title.en: Microsoft unveils Majorana 2, a quantum chip that it developed using AI tools for materials science, and says it will have commercial quantum machines by 2029

summary.zh: 芯片由AI工具开发，用于材料科学研究。

title.zh: Nvidia发布5500亿参数的MoE开源模型Nemotron 3 Ultra
title.en: Nvidia launches Nemotron 3 Ultra, a 550B-parameter MoE open model; Artificial Analysis says it is the smartest open US model, but trails Chinese model Kimi K2.6

summary.zh: 被评为美国最智能的开源模型，但落后于中国的Kimi K2.6。

title.zh: Perplexity推出计算功能，分配任务至本地和云端模型
title.en: Perplexity unveils a Computer feature that splits tasks across local models and cloud-based models, to keep private data on-device and maximize token efficiency

summary.zh: 旨在保护隐私数据并最大化Token效率。

title.zh: AI将颠覆IT咨询行业，更多项目将基于结果定价
title.en: AI will significantly disrupt IT consultancies as AI labs build advisory arms and executives expect more projects priced based on outcome instead of by the hour

summary.zh: AI实验室建立咨询部门，企业高管预期项目定价模式将改变。

title.zh: 谷歌、Anthropic和Meta近期雇佣心理学、伦理学和哲学专家
title.en: Sources: Google, Anthropic, and Meta have hired experts in psychology, ethics, and philosophy in recent months as they expand machine consciousness research

summary.zh: 智谱AI自1月在香港上市以来股价上涨超过10倍。

title.zh: ARM CEO透露甲骨文和字节跳动成为新AGI数据中心CPU客户
title.en: Computex 2026: ARM CEO Rene Haas says Oracle and ByteDance are among the customers of Arm's new AGI CPUs for data centers

summary.zh: 在Computex 2026上，ARM CEO Rene Haas宣布其新AGI CPU已被多家公司采用。

summary.zh: 此举旨在防止技术泄露，应对与美国日益激烈的战略竞争。

title.zh: Salesforce收购CMS提供商Contentful，交易金额约10-15亿美元
title.en: Salesforce is acquiring CMS provider Contentful; a source says Salesforce paid between $1B and $1.5B, a steep discount from Contentful's $3B valuation in 2021

summary.zh: 相比2021年Contentful的30亿美元估值，此次收购价格大幅折让。

title.zh: Thrive Holdings承诺10亿美元收购本地会计公司并用AI自动化其工作流程
title.en: Thrive Capital spinoff Thrive Holdings commits $1B to acquire local accounting firms through its subsidiary, Current, and use AI to automate their workflows

title.zh: 以色列数据安全初创公司Cyera融资3亿美元，估值达120亿美元
title.en: Israeli data security startup Cyera raised $300M at a $12B valuation, after raising $400M at a $9B valuation in January

summary.zh: 此前该公司在1月以90亿美元估值融资4亿美元。

title.zh: Google为Android 12及以上版本添加诈骗检测功能
title.en: Google adds a scam-detection feature, built on RCS, to Android 12 and later that verifies whether a call is coming from the caller's actual Android smartphone

summary.zh: 该功能基于RCS技术，可验证来电是否来自实际的Android智能手机。

title.zh: Sam Altman谈OpenAI的Stargate数据中心项目及AI发展趋势
title.en: Q&A with Sam Altman on OpenAI's Stargate data center project in Saline, Michigan, coding models as the biggest AI demand driver, falling token prices, and more

summary.zh: 讨论了密歇根州Saline的Stargate项目、AI需求驱动因素及代币价格下降等话题。

title.zh: 英国开始使用SpaceX的军事化卫星网络Starshield
title.en: Sources: the UK has begun using SpaceX's militarized satellite network Starshield, making the UK among the first countries outside the US to adopt the tech

summary.zh: 英国成为美国以外首批采用该技术的国家之一。

title.zh: Qwen3.7-Plus：多模态智能代理模型
title.en: Qwen3.7-Plus: Multimodal Agent Intelligence (36 minute read)

summary.zh: 该模型整合了视觉与语言，支持GUI和CLI交互，现已通过阿里云模型工作室提供。
summary.en: Qwen3.7-Plus is a multimodal agent model that unifies vision and language into a single, versatile agent foundation. It can operate as a multimodal interactive hybrid agent, seamlessly blending GUI and CLI interactions within a single agent loop. The model performs consistently across scaffolds and frameworks. Qwen3.7-Plus is now available via Alibaba Cloud Model Studio.

title.zh: OpenAI 和 Codex 登陆 AWS
title.en: OpenAI and Codex Reach AWS (3 minute read)

summary.zh: OpenAI 宣布其前沿模型和 Codex 在 AWS 上全面可用，企业可通过 AWS 的安全、治理、采购和计费流程访问这些能力。
summary.en: OpenAI announced the general availability of its frontier models and Codex on AWS. The integration allows enterprises to access OpenAI capabilities through existing AWS security, governance, procurement, and billing workflows.

title.zh: NVIDIA 发布 Nemotron 3 Ultra
title.en: NVIDIA just announced the release of Nemotron 3 Ultra (2 minute read)

summary.zh: Nemotron 3 Ultra 拥有5500亿参数（其中550亿为活跃参数），是美国最智能的开源权重模型，支持 NVFP4 量化以提升推理性能。
summary.en: Nemotron 3 Ultra features 550B parameters (55B active). It is the most intelligent open weights model from the US. The model will be made available in NVFP4 quantization for higher inference performance. It scores 48 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, well ahead of the next strongest model, Gemma 4 31B, which scored 39. Nemotron 3 Ultra serves over 300 tokens per second on a pre-release Deep Infra endpoint.

title.zh: Anthropic 提交保密 IPO 注册申请
title.en: Anthropic Filed a Confidential Draft IPO Registration (2 minute read)

summary.zh: Anthropic 向美国证券交易委员会提交了保密的 S-1 注册声明，计划进行首次公开募股，具体定价和股份数量尚未确定。
summary.en: Anthropic confidentially submitted a draft S-1 registration statement to the US Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed initial public offering. The filing does not set pricing or share counts and remains subject to regulatory review and market conditions.

title.zh: 视频代理模型的未来：Ethan He 的见解
title.en: Why Video Agent models are next — Ethan He, xAI Grok Imagine (98 minute read)

summary.zh: Ethan He 曾领导 NVIDIA 的 Cosmos World Model 项目，后加入 xAI 并在三个月内开发了 Grok Image。他分享了关于构建前沿图像和视频系统的经验。
summary.en: Ethan He was the lead on Nvidia's Cosmos World Model. He then joined xAI and built Grok Image in three months. He has been in the center of some of the most important work in video generation, multimodal models, and real-time world models. This post contains an interview with He where he unpacks what it actually takes to build frontier image and video systems.

title.zh: 重新定义搜索为代码生成
title.en: Rethinking Search as Code Generation (25 minute read)

summary.zh: Perplexity 推出 Search as Code (SaC)，通过 SDK 让模型直接控制搜索流程，提升性能和效率，尤其在复杂任务中表现出色。
summary.en: Perplexity introduces Search as Code (SaC) to modernize search architectures by allowing models direct control over the search process via an SDK. This approach lets AI models configure search pipelines tailored to specific tasks, improving performance and efficiency over traditional monolithic systems. SaC outperformed competitors in benchmarks, especially in complex tasks like WANDR, demonstrating its robust, cost-effective agentic search capabilities.

title.zh: NVIDIA 推出 Cosmos 3 开放物理 AI 基础模型
title.en: NVIDIA Launches Cosmos 3, the Open Frontier Foundation Model for Physical AI (5 minute read)

summary.zh: Cosmos 3 是一款支持文本、图像、视频、声音和动作生成的多模态模型，采用混合变换器架构，降低数据需求和训练成本。
summary.en: Nvidia Cosmos 3 is a new leaderboard-topping open physical AI foundation model. It is a fully open omnimodel with native vision reasoning and multimodal generation across text, image, video, ambient sound, and action. The model is built on a mixture-of-transformer architecture, which pairs a reasoning transformer with an expert generation transformer. It gives developers a powerful pretrained foundation for building physical AI systems with less data and lower training costs.

title.zh: JetBrains 发布 Mellum 2 编程语言模型
title.en: JetBrains's Mellum 2 (49 minute read)

summary.zh: Mellum 2 是一个拥有 120 亿参数的 MoE 语言模型，专为编程、推理、工具使用和代理工作流优化。
summary.en: JetBrains introduced Mellum 2, a 12B-parameter MoE language model optimized for coding, reasoning, tool use, and agentic workflows.

title.zh: Alphabet 计划通过股票销售筹集 800 亿美元用于 AI 基础设施

summary.zh: Alphabet 将通过股票销售筹集资金，以应对客户对 AI 计算基础设施的空前需求，其中包括伯克希尔哈撒韦的 100 亿美元投资。
summary.en: Alphabet plans to sell $80 billion in stock to fund investments into AI compute infrastructure due to unprecedented customer demand. The raise includes $10 billion from Berkshire Hathaway, $30 billion in an underwritten offering, and $40 billion from an at-the-market offering program for Class A and Class C shares expected to begin in the third quarter. Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan Chase, and Morgan Stanley are acting as joint book-running managers for the underwritten offering.

title.zh: 美国关闭 NVIDIA 高端芯片流向中国企业的漏洞
title.en: US moves to close the loophole letting Nvidia's top chips reach Chinese firms abroad (3 minute read)

summary.zh: 美国商务部发布新规，要求对出售给中国企业的高端芯片实施出口许可限制，旨在阻止通过海外子公司购买芯片的行为。
summary.en: The US Commerce Department has issued guidance extending export license requirements to advance chips sold to any entity headquartered in China, regardless of where that entity is physically located. This closes a loophole that allowed Chinese companies to buy Nvidia chips using a subsidiary in another country. The action is aimed at future sales and not at clawing back hardware already shipped. It doesn't affect the servicing of advanced computing equipment such as servers.

summary.zh: 其中包括12.5亿美元的后期投资基金，标志着其从专注初创企业到增长阶段的转变。

title.zh: 微软推出七款新MAI模型并与梅奥诊所合作开发AI医疗模型
title.en: Building a hill-climbing machine: Launching seven new MAI models (5 minute read)

summary.zh: 新模型支持开发者调整权重并集成到日常产品中，医疗模型将首先在梅奥诊所内部部署。
summary.en: Microsoft released seven new MAI models, enabling developers to tune model weights themselves and integrate these into everyday products. The models leverage Frontier Tuning, an approach where AI adapts to specific workflows through reinforcement learning environments. Microsoft also announced a collaboration with Mayo Clinic to develop an advanced AI healthcare model, combining clinical expertise with AI capabilities, initially deploying within Mayo before wider distribution through Azure Foundry.

title.zh: MiniMax承诺在推出1M上下文模型后发布M3权重
title.en: MiniMax promises M3 weights after 1M-context model launch (2 minute read)

summary.zh: M3模型支持1M-token上下文窗口，是首个结合前沿编码和原生多模态的开源权重模型。
summary.en: MiniMax will release the model weights and a technical report for its M3 model within the next 10 days. The new model is currently available through MiniMax Code, token plans, and an API. It has a 1M-token context window and a guaranteed 512,000-token minimum for API use. The model is the first open-weight model to combine frontier coding, native multimodality, and a 1M-token context window. MiniMax lists standard API pricing up to 512,000 input tokens at $0.60 per million input and $2.40 per million output.

title.zh: Codex 新增六大角色插件功能
title.en: Codex new Capabilities (6 minute read)

summary.zh: OpenAI 发布了 Codex 的新功能，包括六个针对数据分析、创意制作、销售、产品设计、股权投资和投行的角色插件。
summary.en: OpenAI released new Codex capabilities and six role-specific plug-ins for data analytics, creative production, sales, product design, equity investing, and investment banking.

title.zh: 视觉 AI 的下一个前沿：代码生成
title.en: The Next Frontier of Visual AI Is Code (11 minute read)

summary.zh: 视觉 AI 正从生成最终像素输出转向生成可编辑的代码，推动设计和 3D 建模工作流的变革，支持连续迭代和反馈。
summary.en: Visual AI is shifting from generating final pixel outputs to creating source code for editable artifacts, transforming workflows in design and 3D modeling by enabling continuous iteration and feedback. Code-native generation produces structured representations such as HTML/CSS or Blender scripts, facilitating precise edits and enhancements post-generation. This approach holds promise for industries requiring consistent 3D structures and interactive assets, with visual AI moving towards creating adaptive, editable digital artifacts rather than just static images.

title.zh: 开放与封闭模型的不同发展轨迹
title.en: Open and closed models are on different exponentials (8 minute read)

summary.zh: 尽管许多企业希望转向开放模型，但目前这些模型在分布外任务上的表现尚不够好。然而，开放模型生态系统未来将更为多样化，市场价值可能超过封闭模型。
summary.en: A lot of businesses want to switch to open models, but these models aren't yet good enough in out-of-distribution tasks. However, they will eventually catch up. The open model ecosystem will be far more diverse and numerous than the closed lab oligopoly. The total market value of the open model economy will dramatically exceed the cumulative value of OpenAI and Anthropic.

title.zh: 防止大规模 AI 推理盗窃的新方法
title.en: Preventing AI Inference Theft at Scale (5 minute read)

summary.zh: Vercel 介绍了如何通过 BotID 分析验证每个 AI 请求，减少滥用行为，解决传统速率限制不足的问题。
summary.en: Vercel outlined how attackers resell stolen AI inference by exploiting exposed endpoints and highlighted why traditional rate limits are often insufficient. The post describes an approach that verifies every AI request using BotID analysis to reduce abuse.

title.zh: 数据中心迁移至本地设备：Perplexity 推出混合推理系统

summary.en: Perplexity unveiled a hybrid local-cloud inference system at Computex 2026 that intelligently routes queries between on-device models for lightweight tasks and cloud-based models for complex reasoning, building on the company's earlier Personal Computer agent.

title.zh: Anthropic 面临 AI 成本争议，IPO 前景受影响
title.en: Anthropic faces AI spending backlash before IPO (3 minute read)

summary.zh: Anthropic 在 IPO 前面临企业对高昂 AI 成本的质疑，尽管其业务表现强劲，但客户可能转向更便宜的模型或开源替代方案。
summary.en: Anthropic filed for an IPO amid growing corporate scrutiny over high AI costs, which threatens its revenue as companies reevaluate their AI investments. Businesses, Anthropic's key clients, express concerns over spending, with a survey revealing 40% experiencing cost savings below 10%. Despite Anthropic's strong performance, including surpassing OpenAI in business clients, a shift towards cheaper models or open-source alternatives poses a risk.

title.zh: Anthropic 将 Mythos 扩展至 15 个国家的 150 个组织
title.en: Anthropic expands Mythos to 150 additional organizations in more than 15 countries (3 minute read)

summary.zh: Anthropic 将 Project Glasswing 扩展至 150 个合作伙伴，需满足安全要求后方可访问模型，已发现超过 10,000 个高危安全漏洞。
summary.en: Anthropic has expanded Project Glasswing to an additional 150 partners in more than 15 countries. The new partners will need to meet security requirements before gaining access to the model. Since launch, Project Glasswing partners have discovered more than 10,000 high or critical-level security flaws. Major Project Glasswing partners include Apple, Nvidia, Microsoft, CrowdStrike, and Palo Alto Networks.

title.zh: GitHub 的 AI 代理计划
title.en: GitHub's plan for Agents (90 minute read)

summary.zh: GitHub COO Kyle Daigle 讨论了 AI 如何改变公司运作、他在 GitHub 使用 AI 的方式，以及 AI 时代对 GitHub 基础设施的影响。
summary.en: GitHub has been the home for software for almost two decades. Coding agents have seen massive quantities of code being shipped on the platform, which has grown 1,400% this year. This has put pressure on GitHub's infrastructure, which was designed around human developers moving at human speed. This article features an interview with GitHub COO Kyle Daigle where he discusses how AI has changed things in the company, how he uses AI to work at GitHub, why the AI era is breaking GitHub in new ways, and more.

title.zh: 实现大规模连续追踪智能的技术突破
title.en: How we made continuous trace intelligence possible at scale (8 minute read)

summary.en: Braintrust founder Ankur Goyal lays out Topics, the intelligence layer for analyzing production agent traces at scale where million-token traces with hundreds of spans break every standard NLP tool that expects uniform document shapes. Inspired by Anthropic's Clio paper, the pipeline runs preprocess to facet to embed to cluster to name to classify, with the LLM summary doing the one job that makes the rest tractable since the raw trace never has to fit in an embedding model's context window.

summary.en: This post contains a transcript of an interview with Alex Imas, Director of AGI Economics at Google DeepMind, and Philip Trammell, an economics postdoc at Stanford University's Digital Economy Lab, where they answer important questions about how AI is dealt with that only economics can answer. They discuss the optimal way to tax and distribute the wealth that AI will generate, how countries not in the AI supply chain will gain, and whether there's a chance of a future where inequality doesn't explode. Links to the podcast and video of the interview are available.

summary.en: Anthropic's AI model Claude performs well in predicting NMR spectra, matching and sometimes surpassing traditional tools like ChemDraw and MestReNova. Opus 4.7, a Claude variant, accurately predicted hydrogen and carbon shifts on average and demonstrated consistency in replicating results. The AI also proposes chemical structures from spectral data, showing promise in reverse engineering molecular structures, a task typically requiring more complex tools.

summary.en: LLM-assisted coding isn't likely to be affordable anytime soon. While it can enable developers to create things they never would have otherwise been able to before, it isn't economically viable for most use cases. It is only viable now because subscriptions are heavily subsidized. Serious use cases that require loops and 'thinking' using APIs have become very expensive. Developers need to prepare for costs to continue rising and build more resilient systems.

title.zh: 为你的AI代理提供专属计算环境

summary.en: LangSmith introduces Sandboxes, hardware-virtualized microVMs that provide AI agents with their own secure computing environment, directly addressing the risks of running untrusted code. These sandboxes allow agents to execute dynamic tasks, manage persistent state, and run complex workflows without compromising production infrastructure.

summary.en: Xiaomi and inference partner TileRT have created a 1-trillion-parameter model, MiMo-V2.5-Pro-UltraSpeed, with an inference speed of 1,000 tokens per second on a standard 8-GPU commodity node. The speed was achieved through FP4 quantization on the model's expert layers and DFlash speculative decoding, which proposes a full block of tokens in one pass instead of one at a time. The model is available through a limited API trial from June 9 to June 23. It costs three times the standard MiMo-V2.5-Pro rate for roughly 10 times the output.

title.zh: 推出FrontierCode基准测试：评估代码可合并性

summary.en: FrontierCode is a benchmark that measures how well models can truly meet the standards of high-quality production databases. It is the first benchmark to measure code mergeability. The benchmark was crafted by open-source maintainers and features an extensive QC pipeline with adversarial testing, calibration, and multi-stage review. It provides the strongest signal of a model's ability to write high-quality, maintainable code.

title.zh: OpenAI的未来计划：让先进AI普及化

summary.en: Sam Altman and Jakub Pachocki frame OpenAI's three current goals as building an automated AI researcher, accelerating the economy while ensuring gains are widely shared, and giving everyone on Earth a personal AGI. They argue OpenAI has entered its third phase, where the central question is making advanced AI abundant, affordable, safe, and easy enough for every person and organization to use, with broad power distribution as the safer path.

title.zh: 大规模测试时计算的影响

summary.en: Benchmark grids hide the real story because LLM capability is now a function of test-time compute, illustrated by GPT-5.5 looking only marginally better than GPT-5.4 on max-compute cyber evals but substantially stronger once tokens, cost, or latency are controlled on the x-axis. The performance plateau is now empirically very far out and stronger models push the plateau further, so single-scalar benchmark scores will only get less informative each release.

title.zh: AI 正在吞噬 AI 工程循环

summary.en: The AI engineering loop can technically be fully automated now, with every analytics and evals startup undergoing a one-time upgrade into a continual-learning platform, but handing over the whole loop produces agent slop because agents optimize against imperfect evals that miss the nuance only the developer holds.

summary.en: Evo ported its autoresearch orchestrator onto Anthropic's June 2 dynamic workflows in Claude Code, moving the six-step round off the model's in-context memory and into deterministic JavaScript that subagents execute with fresh scoped context. The shift solves long-horizon instruction adherence by making the method the code: phases, fan-out width, stopping rules, gates, and CLI calls are scripted. title.zh: Claude Fable 5 与新的 AI 安全措施
title.en: Claude Fable 5 and new AI safety fables (14 minute read)

summary.zh: Anthropic 推出的 Claude Fable 5 包含一系列安全措施，但这些措施可能导致用户对模型的信任度下降。
summary.en: Anthropic's release of Claude Fable 5 came with the rollout of a series of safety measures, some of which modify the model without telling the user to protect the lab's current lead. Unevenly applied safety policies like this rarely work out. While Anthropic is well within its rights to implement these safeguards, its actions cultivate an 'us against them' dynamic within the AI ecosystem. These actions highlight the need for intelligence that users can trust, modify, and control.

title.zh: 如果 Claude Fable 停止帮助你，你可能永远不会知道

summary.en: Anthropic has limited new interventions that limit Claude's effectiveness in certain situations, including when competing labs use Claude to develop models. Unlike other interventions, these safeguards will not be visible to users and Fable 5 will not fall back to a different model. Instead, they will limit effectiveness through prompt modification, steering factors, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning. While Anthropic claims that these safeguards will only affect 0.03% of developers, it could create a real supply chain risk for businesses as they have no idea if they are running into them, making the company's tools less trustworthy.

title.zh: 无需生成：直接探测LLM隐藏状态的新方法

summary.en: Answers often already exist in LLMs' hidden state before they generate a single token. It's possible to skip generation entirely by grabbing the hidden state at the last prompt token, feeding it to a tiny multilayer perceptron, and calibrating the output. This results in a frozen model that acts as any classifier that can be written in English.

title.zh: 评估LLM对N日漏洞的影响

summary.en: N-days are vulnerabilities that have already been publicly disclosed, but only patched on some devices. They can be more dangerous than zero-day vulnerabilities as the patches provide a roadmap to the bugs. The process of reverse-engineering a vulnerability from a patch has historically been slow and specialized work, but AI can accelerate and automate the process. This means anyone in the patch gap today faces a much larger threat than before.

title.en: Amazon CEO's Talks With US Officials Triggered Crackdown on Anthropic Models (9 minute read)

title.zh: 推理成本的规模化计算方法
title.en: Inference cost at scale with napkin math (13 minute read)

summary.zh: 文章展示了如何通过纸上计算推导用户成本，并分析推理引擎优化对 SaaS 产品盈利能力的影响。
summary.en: You need the following information to work out the dollar price-per-user: GPU hardware specs, context length, active parameter count of the model, and product-specific factors. The specifics of the model architecture matter surprisingly little, unless it's something entirely different, like diffusion. This post shows how to work out the math on paper. The exercise should reveal how various optimizations in inference engines help SaaS products remain profitable.

summary.en: Networks of smaller AI models are outperforming every frontier AI system on speed, accuracy, and cost. Everyone in the 1960s was wrong about the mainframe computer, and everyone is now wrong about centralized AI. The future is a network of neural networks.

title.zh: Fable 模型的物理学解析
title.en: The Physics of a Fable (25 minute read)

summary.zh: 文章分析了 Claude Mythos 和 Fable 的核心竞争力在于环境构建，而非架构本身。
summary.en: Rafa Schwinger reverse-engineers Claude Mythos and Fable by arguing the moat is not architecture but the environment foundry, with capability decomposing as base foundation times gradeable signal extracted on top, and verifiable reward becoming the scarce decisive input now that text and raw compute no longer are. The recipe stacks dense pretraining, GRPO-style verifier RL where reward-hacking soundness is the actual binding constraint, long-horizon process rewards with learned context-folding that beats million-token windows at 32K active, plus best-of-N test-time compute exposed as an effort dial.

title.zh: 通用文本引导的目标计数模型

summary.zh: 该模型在多领域通用性和准确性方面表现出色，解决了现有计数模型的局限性。
summary.en: Object counting is still fragmented across domain-specific data sets and task formulations. Existing counting models are often tailored to specific scenarios and struggle to generalize across categories, visual domains, object scales, and density distributions. This paper presents a generalist model for text-guided object counting that achieves strong accuracy and multi-domain generalization.

title.zh: MiniMax Sparse Attention：支持百万级上下文的稀疏注意力架构
title.en: MiniMax Sparse Attention for Million-Token Contexts (GitHub Repo)

summary.en: MiniMax Sparse Attention is a sparse attention architecture that uses group-specific Top-k block selection to scale long-context inference while preserving model quality. On a 109B multimodal model, it matched GQA performance while cutting attention compute by ~30x at 1M tokens.

The Mixture-of-Experts model has 1 trillion total parameters. It can be accessed on Moonshot's OpenAI/Anthropic compatible API. The model works best with Kimi Code CLI as its agent framework.

title.zh: 推出开放知识格式（Open Knowledge Format）
title.en: Introducing the Open Knowledge Format (9 minute read)

summary.en: The Open Knowledge Format is an open specification that formalizes the LLM-wiki pattern into a portable, interoperable format. It is vendor-neutral and agent- and human-friendly. The standard can represent the metadata, context, and curated knowledge that modern AI systems need. The specification uses familiar patterns with no complex compression scheme, new runtime, or required SDK.

title.zh: olmo-eval：用于模型开发循环的评估工作台

summary.en: olmo-eval is a new evaluation workbench designed for iterative LLM development. Enhancing the OLMES standard, it streamlines adding benchmarks, supports agentic and multi-turn evaluations, and facilitates analysis by comparing changes across model checkpoints. Unlike Harbor, olmo-eval offers flexibility, minimizing resource use and focusing on development rather than public benchmarking.

title.zh: OpenAI与Anthropic的上下文管理方法对比
title.en: The Oracle and the Firm (5 minute read)

summary.zh: OpenAI采用压缩方法保留相关信息，而Anthropic通过子代理分割上下文窗口，可能导致重复工作和信息遗忘。
summary.en: OpenAI and Anthropic have decided on different approaches to context management. OpenAI uses compaction, compressing everything and retaining only the relevant information. This results in one long thread that maintains a lot of coherence. Anthropic splits context windows across various agents, where each agent executes on the sub-problem within its own context window. Sub-agents do a large amount of work, then pass back only the relevant information to the parent agent. Anthropic's approach can result in sub-agents doing duplicate work, forgetting information, and generally wasting more tokens.

The 2026 data converges: Faros AI's 22,000-developer study found code churn up 861%, per-developer defect rate up from 9% to 54%, review duration up 441%, and zero-review merges up 31%, while GitClear shows 4x raw output for ~12% delivered-value gain, the gap being the review problem in one line.

title.zh: AI 推理工程指南

summary.en: Inference engineering is the discipline of running trained AI models in production efficiently. It involves working with low-level GPU code, model serving frameworks, and the cloud infrastructure that ties them together. Engineers need to optimize for a combination of latency, throughput, cost, and quality, depending on the product they're supporting. Inference engineering is now a broad speciality that any company running serious AI workloads invests in.

The playbook Fireworks ran with Ramp, Cursor, and Harvey already proves a tuned open model matches frontier quality at a fraction of the cost, but the deeper question is who owns the intelligence your product runs on.

title.en: Estonia says it will assign personal ID numbers to AI agents to give them “limited, controllable, and auditable authorizations” as they take actions for humans

title.en: Sources: the US has held off adding DeepSeek, CXMT, and 100+ other flagged companies to its Entity List, last updated in October, the longest gap in 10+ years

summary.zh: 这是10多年来更新间隔最长的一次。

title.en: Sources: a new AI lab founded by Junyang Lin, a former lead of Alibaba's Qwen models, has raised several hundred million dollars at a ~$2B post-money valuation

title.en: World models startup Odyssey raised $310M from Amazon and others at a $1.45B valuation and will use AWS as its preferred cloud partner, deploying Trainium chips

title.en: Paris-based Comand AI, which is developing AI-based command-and-control software for military operations, raised a €32M Series A led by Blossom Capital

title.en: Epic says Unreal Engine 6, planned for early access in late 2027, will unify UE5 and Unreal Editor for Fortnite, add integrations with Claude and Gemini, more

title.en: Uber says it will expand its premium robotaxi service from San Francisco to Houston by mid-2027, in partnership with EV maker Lucid and AV startup Nuro

title.en: Sources: Samsung is seeing a rise in advanced chip production requests from BYD, Google, AMD, Tesla, and other companies as AI demand strains TSMC's capacity

title.zh: Databricks年化收入同比增长80%以上，达到69亿美元
title.en: Databricks says its annualized revenue rose 80%+ YoY to $6.9B, up from $5.4B in Q4; CEO Ali Ghodsi says AI agent usage is increasing costs and lowering margins

summary.zh: Databricks CEO Ali Ghodsi表示，AI代理的使用正在增加成本并降低利润率。

title.zh: Frontier承诺追加9.15亿美元购买碳移除信用额度
title.en: Frontier, a group including Stripe, Google, Salesforce, and newly joined Anthropic, commits $915M to buy carbon-removal credits, on top of $1B already pledged

summary.zh: 包括Stripe、Google、Salesforce和Anthropic在内的Frontier集团承诺追加9.15亿美元购买碳移除信用额度，总承诺金额已达10亿美元。

title.zh: Z.ai发布GLM-5.2，支持百万Token上下文窗口
title.en: GLM-5.2 (6 minute read)

summary.zh: GLM-5.2专注于编码任务，提供新的推理控制和长时间跨度代码支持，并计划开放API和MIT许可的权重。
summary.en: Z.ai launched GLM-5.2 with a 1 million-token context window, new reasoning controls, and support for long-horizon coding tasks across entire codebases. The company made the model available immediately to Coding Plan users and plans to release API access, chatbot support, technical details, and MIT-licensed open weights the following week. Z.ai positions GLM-5.2 as a coding-first upgrade focused on agentic software engineering, though it did not publish benchmark results at launch.

title.zh: Android 17扩展AI代理集成功能
title.en: Android 17 Expands AI Agent Integration (8 minute read)

summary.zh: Android 17引入了AppFunctions和Android MCP，支持设备上的AI代理发现和执行工具，推动平台向智能系统转型。
summary.en: Android 17 introduced new AI-focused capabilities centered on AppFunctions and Android MCP, enabling apps to expose orchestratable tools that on-device agents can discover and execute. Google positioned the release as part of a broader shift toward an “intelligence system” with deeper AI integration across the platform.

title.zh: Qwen推出语言驱动的机器人世界模型
title.en: Qwen's Embodied World Modeling (28 minute read)

summary.zh: Qwen-RobotWorld是一种语言驱动的视频世界模型，统一了机器人、导航、驾驶等领域的自然语言操作接口。
summary.en: Qwen-RobotWorld is a language-conditioned video world model that uses natural language as a unified action interface across robotics, navigation, driving, and other embodied domains.

title.zh: Cursor Origin：面向AI代理的GitHub替代品
title.en: Cursor Origin (1 minute read)

summary.zh: Cursor Origin是一个Git兼容的代码托管平台，专为AI代理的并行开发和管理任务设计。
summary.en: Cursor Origin is an attempt at an agent-native GitHub competitor. The Git-compatible forge is built around the assumption that lots of AI agents will be cloning, branching, committing, rebasing, reviewing, and fixing failures in parallel. Cursor is trying to own the whole AI software factory. GitHub was built for human-scale development, but Origin was built for agent-scale.

title.zh: OpenAI为Codex推出浏览器CDP支持
title.en: OpenAI released CDP support for browser use on Codex (2 minute read)

summary.zh: Codex现支持Chrome DevTools协议，可实时分析JavaScript性能并修改网站，标志着OpenAI向AI驱动的网络迈进。
summary.en: OpenAI's Codex now supports Chrome DevTools Protocol, enabling live browser access to profile JavaScript performance and modify websites in real time. This early-stage feature, available via opt-in settings but excluded from the EEA, UK, and Switzerland, faces performance issues and requires careful prompting. Recent OpenAI moves, such as acquiring Ona, aim to create persistent cloud environments, highlighting a push toward an AI-driven web.

title.zh: NVIDIA Blackwell在MLPerf Training 6.0中表现卓越
title.en: Fastest, Largest, Strongest: NVIDIA Blackwell Sweeps MLPerf Training 6.0 (6 minute read)

summary.zh: NVIDIA Blackwell平台以最快训练时间和最大规模训练主导MLPerf Training 6.0基准测试，展示了其在大规模AI环境中的可靠性和性能。
summary.en: NVIDIA's Blackwell platform dominated MLPerf Training 6.0 benchmarks, achieving the fastest training times and the largest-scale training with 8,192 GPUs. Blackwell's NVLink and NVFP4 innovations enhance performance by efficiently routing MoE models and enabling rapid, large-scale training. Reliability features like the Reliability, Availability, and Serviceability Engine and NVIDIA Resiliency Extension ensure minimal downtime and faster recovery in large-scale AI environments.

title.zh: 高通发布面向AI设备的Snapdragon Reality Elite平台
title.en: Qualcomm wants to be the chip inside whatever replaces your smartphone, and it just announced two products toward that end (4 minute read)

summary.zh: 高通推出Snapdragon Reality Elite平台和AI-Ready工具包，旨在成为智能手机后时代AI设备的核心芯片。
summary.en: Qualcomm is working on over 40 different AI wearable devices. It has announced a platform called Snapdragon Reality Elite for mixed-reality glass and the Scalable Turnkey AI-Ready toolkit, a combination of hardware models and a software stack for AI devices. The company is aiming to position itself as the foundational silicon layer for whatever is coming after the smartphone. It is experimenting with a range of potential form factors that can work with AI technologies.

title.zh: OpenAI为ChatGPT语音模式推出GPT-Bidi-1升级
title.en: OpenAI prepares major ChatGPT voice upgrade with GPT-Bidi-1 (2 minute read)

summary.zh: GPT-Bidi-1是一种双向音频模型，支持同时听和说，并能在句中调整响应。
summary.en: GPT-Bidi-1 is a bidirectional audio model for ChatGPT's voice mode designed to listen and speak at once, absorb interruptions, and adjust mid-sentence.

title.zh: 微软测试Phi Silica用于Windows AI，运行于Nvidia GPU
title.en: Microsoft Tests Phi Silica for Windows AI on Nvidia GPUs (6 minute read)

summary.zh: 微软的Phi Silica小型语言模型专为在Windows Copilot+ PC的神经处理单元上本地运行而设计。
summary.en: Microsoft's Phi Silica small language models are explicitly engineered to run locally on the Neural Processing Units of Windows Copilot+ PCs.

title.zh: Noam Shazeer离开Google加入OpenAI担任架构研究负责人
title.en: Noam Shazeer leaves Google to join OpenAI as lead for architecture research; he rejoined Google as a Gemini co-lead in 2024 during the $2.7B Character.AI deal

summary.zh: Noam Shazeer曾在2024年以Gemini联合负责人身份重返Google，期间参与了27亿美元的Character.AI交易。

title.zh: 白宫与Anthropic合作制定AI安全漏洞评估框架
title.en: Sources: the White House and Anthropic are working on a framework that would assess the severity of AI security flaws, a sign that negotiations are progressing

summary.zh: 此举表明双方在相关谈判中取得了进展。

title.zh: 苹果在巴西开放iOS替代应用市场并调整App Store佣金结构
title.en: Apple opens iOS to alternative app marketplaces in Brazil and changes App Store commission structure following a settlement with competition watchdog CADE

summary.zh: 此举是与巴西竞争监管机构CADE达成和解后采取的措施。

title.zh: GLM-5.2成为人工智能指数中领先的开源权重模型
title.en: GLM-5.2 is the leading open weights model on Artificial Analysis' Intelligence Index, scoring 51, only behind Fable 5's 60, Opus 4.8's 56, and GPT-5.5's 55

summary.zh: GLM-5.2在Artificial Analysis的智能指数中得分51，仅次于Fable 5的60分、Opus 4.8的56分和GPT-5.5的55分。

title.zh: 深入解析Meta的AI驱动工程组织重组
title.en: An in-depth look at Meta's AI-fueled rampage through its engineering organization, 30% to 50% of engineers on core teams reassigned to data labeling, and more

summary.zh: 核心团队30%至50%的工程师被重新分配到数据标注等任务。

title.zh: Nvidia研究人员发布ENPIRE框架
title.en: Nvidia researchers unveil ENPIRE, an agent harness framework that develops robotic self-improvement strategies for physical tasks with minimal human supervision

summary.zh: 该框架可开发机器人在物理任务中的自我改进策略，且仅需最少的人类监督。

title.zh: Guardrails Alliance成立，倡导AI安全立法
title.en: Guardrails Alliance, a super PAC that has raised $5M, debuts to advocate for AI safety legislation and counter pro-industry lobbying, running ads for Alex Bores

summary.zh: 该超级政治行动委员会筹集了500万美元，旨在推动AI安全立法并对抗行业游说。

title.zh: 普华永道研究：AI更有利于增强人类技能的企业
title.en: A PwC study suggests that AI is rewarding companies that use it to enhance human skills, while leaving those that use it merely to cut costs further behind

summary.zh: 研究表明，利用AI提升人类技能的企业获益更多，而仅用AI削减成本的企业则逐渐落后。

title.zh: 韩国和台湾科技公司在AI热潮中受益
title.en: South Korean and Taiwanese tech companies that helped build China's hardware sector during the smartphone boom now reap the AI boom as US curbs sideline China

summary.zh: 这些公司曾在智能手机热潮中帮助中国硬件行业发展，如今在美国限制措施下受益。

title.zh: 消息称字节跳动成为微软最大AI客户之一
title.en: Sources: ByteDance has been Microsoft's biggest AI customer in recent years, largely using OpenAI models, and is on track to spend $1B+ a year on Azure services

summary.zh: 字节跳动主要使用OpenAI模型，预计每年在Azure服务上的支出将超过10亿美元。

title.zh: 亚马逊计划向第三方数据中心出售定制Trainium AI芯片
title.en: Amazon's AI chief Peter DeSantis says the company is in talks to sell its custom Trainium AI chips for use in third-party data centers

title.zh: 消息称Kalshi年化收入超20亿美元，计划IPO
title.en: Sources: Kalshi is generating $2B+ in annualized revenue, up about three times from November, and has held informal talks with banks about an eventual IPO

title.zh: 消息称腾讯等中国早期投资者计划以20亿美元回购Manus
title.en: Sources: the early Chinese backers of Manus, including HSG, ZhenFund, and Tencent, plan to buy the AI startup back from Meta at the $2B price Meta paid

title.zh: 埃森哲将收购Dragos多数股权并全资收购runZero和NetRise
title.en: Accenture says it will buy a majority stake in Dragos and fully acquire runZero and NetRise in a combined deal for the cybersecurity startups valued at $4.18B

summary.zh: 此次收购涉及的网络安全初创公司总估值为41.8亿美元。

title.zh: AI推理初创公司Baseten融资15亿美元，估值达110亿至130亿美元
title.en: AI inference startup Baseten is raising $1.5B in a dual-tiered deal, with some investors putting in money at an $11B valuation and others at a $13B valuation

title.zh: General Intuition计划融资3亿美元，估值超20亿美元
title.en: Sources: General Intuition, which trains AI agents in spatial reasoning, is in talks to raise $300M from Jeff Bezos and others at a $2B+ valuation

title.zh: Dream公司融资2.6亿美元，估值从2025年的10亿美元增至30亿美元
title.en: Dream, co-founded by ex-NSO Group CEO Shalev Hulio with a focus on protecting critical infrastructure, raised $260M at a $3B valuation, up from $1B in 2025

summary.zh: Dream由前NSO Group CEO创立，专注于保护关键基础设施。

title.zh: 消息称欧盟下周将公布AWS和Azure符合DMA监管标准的初步调查结果
title.en: Sources: as early as next week, the EU is set to unveil its preliminary findings that AWS and Azure seem to meet the criteria for regulation under the DMA

title.zh: ChatGPT市场份额首次跌破50%
title.en: ChatGPT's market share slips below 50% for first time (4 minute read)

summary.zh: 用户正在转向其他助手，如Google的Gemini、Anthropic的Claude和xAI的Grok。
summary.en: ChatGPT's market share has dipped below 50% for the first time. Users are migrating to other assistants like Google's Gemini, Anthropic's Claude, and xAI's Grok. ChatGPT was the fastest app to ever reach a billion monthly users, and it still remains the most popular AI assistant worldwide. Users are increasingly willing to switch between assistants.

title.zh: ChatGPT改进任务调度功能并停用Pulse
title.en: ChatGPT Improves Scheduled Tasks and Retires Pulse (1 minute read)

summary.zh: 新功能提升了速度和可靠性，适用于Go、Plus、Pro、Business和Enterprise用户。
summary.en: ChatGPT has introduced an improved task scheduling feature, enhancing speed and reliability. It is accessible via the new Scheduled page and available to Go, Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users.

title.zh: 大型语言模型是否过度推理？
title.en: Brain the Size of a Planet: Are LLMs Thonking too Hard? (30 minute read)

summary.zh: 研究发现更高的推理努力甚至更新的模型并不总是更适合安全结果的筛选。
summary.en: Earlier studies showed that Opus 4.6, GPT 5.4, Gemini 3.1-pro-preview, Deepseek R1-0528, and Qwen 3.6-plus were unable to find two of the vulnerabilities discussed in the Mythos blog post without extremely revealing hints. This study continues the previous experiments with 26 distinct Claude-4.6/4.7 and GPT-5.4/5.5 combinations and different context window sizes and reasoning efforts. It found that higher reasoning effort, and even later models, are not always better for triaging security results.

title.zh: Vercel 推出开源代理框架 eve
title.en: Production Infrastructure for AI Agents (19 minute read)

summary.zh: eve 提供持久执行、沙盒计算、审批等功能，帮助开发者专注于代理行为。
summary.en: Vercel introduced eve, an open-source agent framework with built-in capabilities such as durable execution, sandboxed compute, approvals, subagents, and evaluations. It aims to let developers focus on agent behavior while the framework handles production concerns.

title.zh: MolmoMotion：基于语言指导的3D运动预测模型
title.en: MolmoMotion: Language-guided 3D motion forecasting (9 minute read)

summary.zh: MolmoMotion 能通过语言指令和初始位置预测视频中3D点的未来轨迹，性能优于现有方法。
summary.en: MolmoMotion, a new motion forecasting model, predicts future 3D point trajectories in videos using language instructions and initial object positions, outperforming existing methods. The model and its dataset, MolmoMotion-1M, feature vast datasets of 3D point trajectories from 1.16M videos, with a benchmark for accuracy testing.

title.zh: NVIDIA XR AI：为AR眼镜和XR设备构建AI代理
title.en: Building AI Agents for AR Glasses and XR Devices with NVIDIA XR AI (12 minute read)

summary.zh: NVIDIA XR AI 提供开源库，支持开发能理解用户意图并实时响应的智能代理。
summary.en: Nvidia XR AI provides a reusable foundation for connecting extended reality devices to GPU-accelerated AI services running in the cloud, data center, workstation, or edge. It gives developers access to an open source library for building intelligent agents for AI glasses, AR glasses, and XR headsets. These agents will be able to see what users see, understand token or typed intent, call enterprise tools, and respond within the same XR session. XR AI is now available in public beta.

title.zh: Cursor 推出新模型，推动代理软件开发
title.en: Cursor's new model (1 minute read)

summary.zh: 新模型拥有1.5万亿参数，超越代码任务智能，预计数周内发布。
summary.en: Cursor's new model will push agentic software development far beyond autocomplete and pair programming. The massive model was trained from scratch on over 100,000 GPUs. It has more than 1.5 trillion parameters and delivers intelligence beyond coding tasks. The model will be released in the coming weeks.

title.zh: Noam Shazeer 加入 OpenAI
title.en: Noam Shazeer is joining OpenAI (1 minute read)

summary.zh: Noam Shazeer 曾是Transformer论文的联合作者，现从Google转投OpenAI。
summary.en: Noam Shazeer is leaving Google to join OpenAI. Shazeer was one of the co-authors of the 2017 paper - 'Attention Is All You Need' - that transformed the AI world. He also improved search spelling correction and created the core algorithm for AdSense.

title.zh: OpenAI 推出 LifeSciBench 生命科学基准测试
title.en: Introducing LifeSciBench (7 minute read)

summary.zh: 该基准测试评估AI系统在生命科学工作流中的综合能力，而非单一任务表现。
summary.en: OpenAI introduced LifeSciBench, an expert-judged benchmark that evaluates AI systems on end-to-end life sciences workflows such as evidence analysis, experimental design, scientific reasoning, and research communication rather than isolated biology tasks.
